fact: On 16 October 2026 a consultant presented to the Eswatini EMIS Data Use Workshop a draft Data Use Action Brief for October 2026 to December 2027, proposing validation checks in the termly EMIS reporting tool, training for school EMIS focal persons and connectivity support for schools that struggle to submit returns on time.
title: ESWATINI TARGETS EDUCATION DATA GAPS WITH 15-MONTH ACTION PLAN
